Name: Family Choices Expanded
Author: LavenderLight
TagLine: Configurable options for child rearing and/or adopting.
Description:
**What Is It:**
A CP mod to edit how you have kids with your spouse.
Maybe you play with a gender bend mod, or maybe you just want to adopt regardless of who you marry.
This lets you config each vanilla spouse to your liking.
It's set to adopt for everyone by default.
**Options:**
__Adopt __- you will only adopt children.
__Spouse__ - have children biologically, your spouse will be the one to get pregnant.
__Farmer __- player character is the one to get pregnant

**Bonus:**
Also includes some slight dialogue tweaks to be less awkward. No more babies dumped on your doorstep during the middle of the night by Stardew Valley's worst adoption agency!

**How To Use:**

1.  Have [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)﻿

2.  Toss it into your Mods Folder

3.  Open it up, open the Config file.

4.  Edit each spouse to your liking.

5.  Save and play!
